name: Gedocarnil
summary: Gedocarnil (INN) is an anxiolytic of the β-carboline family related to abecarnil. It is registered as an anxiolytic under the WHO's ATC classification system; however, there are no trade names associated with it and it does not appear to have ever been marketed.

uses.text: It is registered as an anxiolytic under the WHO's ATC classification system; however, there are no trade names associated with it and it does not appear to have ever been marketed.

pharmacology.en: Like its relative abecarnil, it is thought to act at the benzodiazepine site of GABAA receptors, boosting the calming effect of GABA.
pharmacology.zh: 和它的近親 abecarnil 一樣，它被認為作用於 GABAA 受體的苯二氮平結合位，增強 GABA 的鎮靜作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和它的近亲 abecarnil 一样，它被认为作用于 GABAA 受体的苯二氮平结合位，增强 GABA 的镇静作用。

fact.en: Gedocarnil is a beta-carboline, the same ring family as harmine from Syrian rue. Some beta-carbolines calm anxiety while others at the same receptor site cause it.
fact.zh: Gedocarnil 屬於 β-咔啉類，和駱駝蓬裡的哈爾明是同一個環系家族。有些 β-咔啉能緩解焦慮，有些卻會在同一受體位置引發焦慮。
fact.zhHans: Gedocarnil 属于 β-咔啉类，和骆驼蓬里的哈尔明是同一个环系家族。有些 β-咔啉能缓解焦虑，有些却会在同一受体位置引发焦虑。
